name: TraditionalChineseMedicine-Benchmark
description: A dataset benchmarking model performance on Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) knowledge tasks, typically including question answering and knowledge-retrieval style prompts about herbs, diagnoses, and formulas. It is intended to evaluate language models' factual and reasoning ability within the specialized domain of TCM. The dataset is niche and focused on domain-specific medical knowledge rather than general-language understanding.
evaluation_method: accuracy and exact_match for QA/multiple-choice items
reputation: A niche, domain-specific benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with limited adoption outside specialized TCM and domain-medicine research communities.
